_comment: Guard recipes that no workflow and no CI-family registry can reach.
This file is a ratchet, not an exemption: scripts/guard_reachability.py fails
on any orphan NOT listed here, and also fails when a listed name stops being
an orphan, so entries have to be removed as they are fixed.
Recorded 2026-08-20 from issue #92. Each entry needs its owner to either wire
it into CI or delete it as superseded. Do not add to this list to silence a

Not every entry should be wired. Some are unreachable BY DESIGN and are still load-bearing: guard-cloud-heavy-ci-surface asserts that heavy-guards.yml must NOT run guard-mir-feature-migration-suite, because it was deliberately split into migration-* matrix shards; and guard-mir-ast-to-c-retirement-manifest-surface and guard-mir-to-c-boring-surface both parse that recipe's BODY as a specification. Deleting it would break two guards. Check for readers before removing anything here.
Several entries are deliberate manual/debug lanes rather than gaps. GEMINI.md records the Step 5.1 intent explicitly. Read the per-entry notes before triaging.

Being on this list does NOT mean the recipe was forgotten. As of the 2026-08-20 triage, none of the 22 is a known coverage gap: the guard-mir-* ones are staged pending their feature's migration, the guard-step51-* ones are deliberate debug lanes, and the two migration ones are by design. The value of the check is stopping number 23 appearing unnoticed.

Re-baselined 2026-09-14 by Patch 24.15a (issue #393). The 45 entries owned by 'Patch 24.16 cross-feature residue audit' are NOT new orphans being silenced -- they were orphans all along, hidden because guard_reachability.py subtracted every name a CI-family registry mentioned. Mention is not execution: measured when the exemption was removed, 28 of the 45 have no caller at all and 17 are called only by recipes that are themselves unreachable, and none is the target of a reachable dispatcher. Each carries a per-entry reason below stating the route it lacks and the mention that hid it. Deciding which to wire and which to retire is Patch 24.16's; recording that they are unreachable is the instrument repair's.
